subject.title: fix(feishu): upgrade single newlines to double for md tag

question: Should maintainers repair this branch into the canonical Feishu newline fix, or switch to a sibling branch such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99394 after its conflicts are resolved?
rationale: The remaining choice is not only mechanical: multiple candidate PRs exist, this branch has a known delivery-limit defect, and one sibling has stronger proof but is not currently cleanly mergeable.

options.title: Repair this branch before merge
options.body: Require chunk-safe send/reply/edit handling plus live Feishu proof on this PR before treating it as canonical.

options.title: Adopt the proof-positive sibling after conflict repair
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99394 as the canonical fix only after it is cleanly mergeable and maintainers accept its fanout behavior.

options.title: Leave candidates open for now
options.body: Keep this PR and siblings open until one branch has both clean merge state and accepted proof, at the cost of continued duplicate review churn.
